source_identity_receipt_checks.interpretation: Full workflow sources are exact frozen commits. Some earlier targeted experiments used uncommitted or isolated module copies; recorded file hashes, rather than checkout HEAD alone, establish the tested implementation.

distributed_file_mappings.exclusion: Private launch/compute-environment metadata. Scientific workflow IDs, source commits, settings and results have separate public records.
